theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ψ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (V Y : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (h : Euclid P → ℝ) (H : Euclid P → Euclid P), MeasurableSet M → (∀ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C → μHE[n + 1] (M ∩ C) ≠ ∞) → IsOpen V → ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → InjOn ψ V → (∀ y ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → ContDiff ℝ 1 F → MeasurableSet Y → IsCompact (closure Y) → closure Y ⊆ V → ψ '' Y ⊆ M → (∀ y ∈ Y, h (ψ y) = F y) → (∀ y ∈ Y, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt (n + 1) M (ψ y) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt (n + 1) M x (approxTangentPlane (n + 1) M x) ∧ H x ∈ approxTangentPlane (n + 1) M x ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μHE[n + 1] (M ∩ ball x r ∩ {y | ε * ‖y - x‖ < |h y - h x - inner ℝ (H x) (y - x)|}) / ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (n + 1))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict (ψ '' Y)), ∀ y ∈ Y, ψ y = x → H x ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ∧ ∀ e : Euclid (n + 1), inner ℝ (H x) (fderiv ℝ ψ y e) = fderiv ℝ F y e
